domain_description: Tests whether a broad participation impulse creates a cleaner continuation edge than single-asset momentum.
description: Cross-sectional breadth thrust followed by a leader breakout.
fixed_conditions: 1H breadth >= 67%; 6H breadth impulse >= 33 percentage points; 24H relative-strength percentile >= 67%; 72H relative-strength percentile >= 50%; close above prior 12H high; volume >= 1.20 x 20H median; 4H and 1D trend aligned

domain_description: Tests whether a causal loss of BTC leadership identifies profitable alt rotation without using derivatives data.
description: Leadership rotation from BTC into a top-ranked non-BTC asset.
fixed_conditions: non-BTC symbol only; BTC 24H lead crosses from non-negative to <= -1%; 1H breadth >= 50%; 24H relative-strength percentile >= 83%; 72H relative-strength percentile >= 67%; close above prior 6H high; volume >= 1.10 x 20H median; 4H and 1D trend aligned

domain_description: Tests whether widening cross-sectional opportunity sets contain an exploitable leader effect.
description: Top-ranked leader breakout as cross-sectional return dispersion expands above a causal threshold.
fixed_conditions: 24H return dispersion crosses above prior 200H 75th percentile; equal-weight 24H market return > 0; 24H relative-strength percentile >= 83%; close above prior 12H high; volume >= 20H median; 4H and 1D trend aligned

domain_description: Tests whether broad spot-volume participation improves the quality of price-only breakouts.
description: Broad spot-volume participation thrust with a top-ranked asset breakout.
fixed_conditions: fraction of assets with volume >= 1.25 x median crosses 50%; 1H price breadth >= 67%; 24H relative-strength percentile >= 67%; close above prior 6H high; close location >= 65%; 4H and 1D trend aligned

domain_description: Tests whether falling market co-movement creates a causal cross-sectional selection opportunity.
description: Top-ranked rotation after average pairwise correlation releases from a high-correlation regime.
fixed_conditions: prior 72H average pairwise correlation >= 0.65; current 72H average pairwise correlation <= 0.55; 72H relative-strength percentile >= 83%; 1H breadth >= 50%; close > EMA20 > EMA50; volume >= 20H median; 4H and 1D trend aligned
